name: field
title: Field
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: A labelled value on a grey fill, with an optional prefix and hint. Use for any form input.

hairline.example: <Field label="Amount" size="lg" prefix="XAF" value="250 000" hint="Leaves nothing until the 28th." />
hairline.antiExampleWhy: A placeholder is not a label, and the field loses the system's fill, radius and figure treatment.

docs: Use `size="lg"` for the single amount a form is about — never for two. Pass `editable` for a real input.
